import sys
from collections import defaultdict
def main():
    d = defaultdict(float)
    f = sys.stdin.buffer
    f.readline()
    for line in f:
        p = line.split(b',')
        if len(p) >= 3:
            d[p[1]] += float(p[2])
    out = ["%s,%.2f" % (k.decode(), d[k]) for k in sorted(d)]
    print("\n".join(out))
main()

import sys
from collections import defaultdict
def main():
    d = defaultdict(float)
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split(b'\n')
    for line in data[1:]:
        p = line.split(b',')
        if len(p) >= 3:
            d[p[1]] += float(p[2])
    print("\n".join("%s,%.2f" % (k.decode(), d[k]) for k in sorted(d)))
main()

import sys
from collections import defaultdict
def main():
    d = defaultdict(list)
    f = sys.stdin.buffer
    f.readline()
    for line in f:
        p = line.split(b',')
        if len(p) >= 3:
            d[p[1]].append(p[2])
    print("\n".join("%s,%.2f" % (k.decode(), sum(map(float,d[k]))) for k in sorted(d)))
main()
